ios.desc:
Entropy is the idea that everything naturally falls into chaos — your sleep, your diet, your focus, your body. Every day is a quiet battle to maintain order.

Entropy helps you win that battle.

Instead of overwhelming you with a long list of goals, Entropy breaks each habit into small, achievable steps. Ate one balanced meal? That's a step. Sat down to meditate? That's a step. Each action moves your Order Score closer to 100%.

Your Order Score isn't just based on what you've done — it's time-aware. At 9am, being at 30% is fine. At 9pm, it's a warning. The app knows the difference and tells you honestly where you stand.

FEATURES
- Smart step-by-step habits — complete goals one micro-action at a time
- Time-aware Order Score — know if you're ahead or behind pace
- Smart reminders — only nudged when you actually need it
- Performance log — track your daily scores over time
- Dark mode — full system dark mode support
- iCloud sync — your data follows you across devices
- Apple and Google Sign In — no passwords needed

ENTROPY PRO
Upgrade to unlock unlimited habits, 14 days of history, and advanced pacing insights.

Start fighting entropy today.
